model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the loss values over the course of training iterations for five different models, with the y-axis representing “Loss” on a linear scale ranging from 2.4 to 3.4, and the x-axis representing “#Iteration” on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 140,000. The plot includes five distinct lines: a purple line labeled “Vanilla,” a blue line labeled “StrmLLM (n=64),” an orange line labeled “SepLLM (n=64),” a green line labeled “SepLLM (n=64, H),” a red line labeled “SepLLM (n=64, H/T),” and a dark blue line labeled “SepLLM (n=128).” All lines begin at a high loss value near 3.4 at iteration 0 and exhibit a rapid initial decline, followed by a gradual flattening into a stable range between approximately 2.5 and 2.6. The “Vanilla” model starts at a loss of approximately 3.4 and decreases to around 2.5. The “StrmLLM (n=64)” model begins at approximately 3.3 and settles near 2.7. The “SepLLM (n=64)” model starts near 3.3 and stabilizes around 2.6. The “SepLLM (n=64, H)” model begins near 3.3 and settles around 2.55. The “SepLLM (n=64, H/T)” model starts near 3.3 and stabilizes around 2.5. The “SepLLM (n=128)” model begins near 3.3 and settles around 2.6. All lines show noisy fluctuations around their final stable loss values.
